runnerText:
"""Actual native child-worker CUDA capture/cache/reopen acceptance, not speedup evidence."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'python'))
from lpbf_worker import Queue
from lpbf_simulation import implementation_fingerprint
from lpbf_gpu_thermal import enforce_gpu_pilot_result, PARITY_TARGETS
from lpbf_gpu_pilot_artifacts import read_pilot_artifacts
from lpbf_gpu_pilot_numerics import validate_pilot_numerics

DEST = ROOT / 'docs/LPBF_GPU_NATIVE_WORKER_ACCEPTANCE_RETRY_2026-09-27'
REPORT = ROOT / 'docs/LPBF_GPU_NATIVE_WORKER_ACCEPTANCE_RETRY_2026-09-27.json'
CASE = {'jobType': 'gpu-thermal-pilot', 'mode': 'standard', 'backend': 'cuda:0',
        'material': 'Inconel 718', 'power_W': 60, 'speed_mm_s': 1200,
        'mesh_um': 40, 'maxDt_s': 2e-7, 'preheat_C': 80, 'layer_um': 80,
        'trackLength_um': 200, 'cooling_s': 2e-5, 'dwell_s': 0}

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

if DEST.exists() or REPORT.exists():
    raise FileExistsError('Preserve prior native-worker evidence')
before = implementation_fingerprint()
paths = ['python/lpbf_worker.py', 'python/lpbf_run_capture.py',
         'src/services/lpbfSimulationService.ts', 'python/lpbf_gpu_pilot_numerics.py']
source_hashes = {name: digest(ROOT / name) for name in paths}
queue = Queue(DEST, start=False)
started = time.perf_counter()
try:
    submitted = queue.submit(CASE, execution_scope='repeat')
    job = submitted['id']
    assert submitted['cacheHit'] is False
    queue.update(job, status='running')
    queue.execute(job)
    completed = queue.get(job)
    assert completed['status'] == 'completed', completed
    result = completed['result']
    folder = DEST / job
    capture = queue.capture(job)
    assert capture['contractStatus'] == 'gpu-pilot-v1-bound'
    assert capture['runKind'] == result['runKind'] == 'gpu-thermal-pilot'
    assert 'coreContract' not in result
    assert json.loads(capture['resultJson']) == result
    for key, serialized in [('inputJson', 'requestJson'), ('materialJson', 'materialJson')]:
        assert capture[key] == result['gpuRunContract']['serializedInputs'][serialized]
    states = read_pilot_artifacts(folder, result['gpuFieldArtifacts'])
    proof = validate_pilot_numerics(result, states, PARITY_TARGETS)
    enforce_gpu_pilot_result(result, artifact_dir=folder)
    cached = queue.submit(CASE)
    assert cached['cacheHit'] is True and cached['id'] == job
    assert cached['result'] == result
finally:
    queue.close()
reopened = Queue(DEST, start=False)
try:
    assert reopened.get(job)['result'] == result
    assert reopened.capture(job) == capture
finally:
    reopened.close()
after = implementation_fingerprint()
assert before == after == result['provenance']['implementationHash']
assert source_hashes == {name: digest(ROOT / name) for name in paths}
head = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True,
                      text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
report = {'schemaVersion': 1, 'scope': 'Actual native CUDA child-worker / byte-numeric capture / cache / reopen',
          'experimentalValidation': False, 'productionReady': False,
          'executionHead': head, 'executionSourceHashes': source_hashes,
          'implementationFingerprintBefore': before, 'implementationFingerprintAfter': after,
          'runnerText': Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
          'runnerSha256': digest(Path(__file__)), 'jobId': job,
          'artifactDirectory': folder.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
          'resultSha256': digest(folder / 'result.json'), 'capture': capture,
          'sameRunProof': proof, 'cacheRevalidated': 'pass', 'reopenedReadback': 'pass',
          'wallSeconds': time.perf_counter() - started,
          'performanceEvidence': 'Single acceptance duration; no speedup or throughput claim'}
REPORT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'jobId': job, 'status': proof['status'], 'files': len(result['artifacts']),
                  'wallSeconds': report['wallSeconds'], 'reportSha256': digest(REPORT)}))
